name: ngrok
label: ngrok API
description: ngrok API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://ngrok.com/docs/api/. Operations: tunnel_list, tunnel_get, edge_get, reserved_domain_list, listen. tunnel_list/tunnel_get call GET /endpoints (Cloud Endpoints). edge_get (GET /edges/https/{id}) is deprecated — Edges sunset 2025-12-31 (https://ngrok.com/docs/gateway/edges). Every request sends Ngrok-Version: 2 via extraHeaders. Auth secret api_key is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: tunnel_list | tunnel_get | edge_get | reserved_domain_list | listen. edge_get is deprecated (Edges sunset 2025-12-31). Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'tunnel_list'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Endpoint or HTTPS edge id for tunnel_get / edge_get.

schema.label: before_id
schema.description: Pagination cursor (list items before this id).

schema.label: edge_type
schema.description: Edge protocol for edge_get path /edges/{edge_type}/{id}. EXACT: https | tcp | tls.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: tunnel_list, tunnel_get, edge_get, reserved_domain_list, listen. edge_get is deprecated (Edges sunset 2025-12-31). listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: ngrok API key. Authorization: Bearer. Ngrok-Version: 2 is sent via extraHeaders (https://ngrok.com/docs/api/).

configurationParameters.label: Edge Type
configurationParameters.description: Edge protocol for edge_get path /edges/{edge_type}/{id}. EXACT: https | tcp | tls.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
